nodes.label: Energy Sorcerer Front Walk and Idle Reference Sheet
nodes.description: Third-party asset-pack sprite sheet used as reference, and the only partial sheet in this set: a single row of 4 front-facing frames on magenta chroma key, covering idle and the front walk cycle only. No back or side rows and no attack row. Archetype: bearded lightning/energy sorcerer in blue and gold layered robes with a raised crystal-tipped staff, arcing electric VFX around both arms and a lightning-bolt sigil on the tabard. Art style: the highest-resolution and most detailed of the set, painterly pixel shading with saturated blue glow.
nodes.rationale: Sampled at higher zoom than the other sheets to study per-frame VFX (electric arcs redrawn each frame) rather than the sheet layout.

nodes.label: Energy Sorcerer Archetype (lightning caster)
nodes.description: Offensive caster class: staff-wielding lightning mage with persistent ambient electricity VFX bound to the idle pose itself.

nodes.label: Magenta Chroma-Key Background
nodes.description: Background convention on two of these sheets: pure magenta as the transparency key, versus solid black on the knight sheets and white/transparent on the ranger sheet.
nodes.rationale: Magenta is chosen because it appears nowhere in the character palettes, so a key-out never eats sprite pixels; black backgrounds on the knight sheets are riskier since the black knight's armor nearly matches them.
